edges.reason: msg.sender determines which account balance is debited in transfer, so the caller controls the mutated state entry.
msg.sender is used as the spender key of the allowance in transferFrom, controlling whose allowance is consumed.
msg.sender is the owner key under which allowances are written in approve.
msg.sender receives the whole initial supply in the DecenturionToken constructor.
msg.sender is passed to allowance() to validate the assumed current allowance in the three-argument approve.
msg.sender is the account whose balance and the supply are reduced in burnTokens.
_owner selects the mapping entry returned by balanceOf.
_to is the recipient key credited in transfer.
_value is the amount checked against fromBalance and moved in transfer.
_from selects the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
_to is the recipient key credited in transferFrom.
_value is the amount checked against allowance and balance and moved in transferFrom.
_spender is the spender key of the allowance written in approve.
_value is written directly into the allowance mapping in approve.
_owner is the outer key read by allowance.
_spender is the inner key read by allowance.
x is the first operand of safeAdd.
y is the second operand of safeAdd.
x is the minuend of safeSub.
y is the subtrahend of safeSub.
x is the first factor of safeMul.
y is the second factor of safeMul.
_tokenCount is assigned to tokenCount and to accounts[msg.sender].
_spender is forwarded to allowance() and to approve().
_currentValue is compared against the stored allowance in the three-argument approve.
_newValue is forwarded to AbstractToken.approve.
_value is the amount burned in burnTokens.
x is an operand of the uint256 addition performed by safeAdd.
y is an operand of the uint256 addition performed by safeAdd.
x is an operand of the uint256 subtraction performed by safeSub.
y is an operand of the uint256 subtraction performed by safeSub.
x is an operand of the uint256 multiplication performed by safeMul.
y is an operand of the uint256 multiplication performed by safeMul.
_value flows as the subtrahend into safeSub(fromBalance, _value) in transfer.
_value flows as the subtrahend into safeSub in transferFrom for allowance and balance.
_value flows as an addend into safeAdd(accounts[_to], _value) in transferFrom.
_value flows into safeSub for both the balance and tokenCount updates in burnTokens.
transfer reads accounts[msg.sender] into the fromBalance local.
fromBalance is the minuend passed to safeSub in transfer.
transferFrom reads allowances[_from][msg.sender] into spenderAllowance.
transferFrom reads accounts[_from] into the fromBalance local.
spenderAllowance is the minuend of safeSub when reducing the allowance.
fromBalance is the minuend of safeSub when debiting the sender balance.
DecenturionToken.totalSupply returns tokenCount through the supply local.
The x + y addition result is returned as z by safeAdd.
The x - y subtraction result is returned as z by safeSub.
The x * y multiplication result is returned as z by safeMul.
safeAdd contains the unchecked uint256 addition after the assert overflow guard.
safeSub contains the uint256 subtraction after the assert underflow guard.
safeMul contains the uint256 multiplication after the overflow guard.
safeAdd reads MAX_UINT256 to bound the addition.
safeMul reads MAX_UINT256 to bound the multiplication.
transfer writes the updated balances of msg.sender and _to into accounts.
balanceOf reads accounts[_owner].
transferFrom updates accounts[_from] and accounts[_to].
transferFrom reads and decreases allowances[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowances[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance reads allowances[_owner][_spender].
The constructor credits accounts[msg.sender] with the minted tokens.
The constructor initializes tokenCount with _tokenCount.
totalSupply reads tokenCount.
burnTokens reduces accounts[msg.sender] by _value.
burnTokens reduces tokenCount by _value.
safeAdd result is assigned back into the accounts mapping entries in transfer/transferFrom.
safeSub result is assigned back into the accounts mapping entries when debiting a holder.
safeSub result is written back into the allowances mapping in transferFrom.
safeSub(tokenCount, _value) writes the reduced supply into tokenCount in burnTokens.
Token.balanceOf interface declaration is implemented against the accounts mapping.
Token.transfer interface declaration is implemented against the accounts mapping.
Token.transferFrom interface declaration is implemented against the accounts mapping.
Token.transferFrom interface declaration is implemented against the allowances mapping.
Token.approve interface declaration is implemented against the allowances mapping.
Token.allowance interface declaration is implemented against the allowances mapping.
Token.totalSupply interface declaration is implemented by the tokenCount state variable.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for allowance and balance updates.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
burnTokens invokes safeSub for the balance and tokenCount updates.
The three-argument approve delegates to AbstractToken.approve when the assumed allowance matches.
The three-argument approve calls allowance(msg.sender, _spender) to validate _currentValue.
The DecenturionToken constructor inherits and implicitly executes the AbstractToken constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only indexes the accounts mapping read by this function and has no independent semantics.
_to is only used as the credited mapping key inside transfer.
_value only parameterizes the amount moved and checked by transfer.
_from only selects the debited account and the allowance owner inside transferFrom.
_to only serves as the credited mapping key inside transferFrom.
_value only parameterizes the amount moved and checked by transferFrom.
_spender is only the spender key of the allowance written by approve.
_value is written verbatim into the allowance mapping by approve.
_owner is only the outer mapping key read by allowance.
_spender is only the inner mapping key read by allowance.
x is only an operand of the guarded addition performed inside safeAdd.
y is only an operand of the guarded addition performed inside safeAdd.
x is only an operand of the guarded subtraction performed inside safeSub.
y is only an operand of the guarded subtraction performed inside safeSub.
x is only an operand of the guarded multiplication performed inside safeMul.
y is only an operand of the guarded multiplication performed inside safeMul.
_tokenCount only defines tokenCount and the initial balance minted by the constructor.
_spender is forwarded unchanged to allowance/approve by the three-argument approve.
_currentValue is only compared with the stored allowance as a double-spend guard.
_newValue is only forwarded to AbstractToken.approve.
_value only parameterizes the amount burned by burnTokens.
fromBalance is a cached copy of accounts[msg.sender] used only within transfer.
spenderAllowance is a cached copy of the caller allowance used only within transferFrom.
fromBalance is a cached copy of accounts[_from] used only within transferFrom.
supply is the trivial return alias of tokenCount in totalSupply.
z is the value produced directly by the addition inside safeAdd.
z is the value produced directly by the subtraction inside safeSub.
z is the value produced directly by the multiplication inside safeMul.
